row.notes: Per-car garage release logic. Resolves the entrant row (table +0x2e0, elem 0x88, car index at car_ctx+0xc4), checks session type at (+0x58)+0x1a8 +4 and flag byte +0x4b bit 0x10 to early-out, computes session time and a normalised session progress, evaluates a curve (Career_Eval_Curve) to get max cars allowed on track and counts cars in states DAT_14604a4a0/a4. Under critical section DAT_146103328 inspects the global queue DAT_1461032e8 of {u8 car, f32 time}: if this car is at the front and its time and global next-release time DAT_146103358 have passed, removes it, re-sorts, calls Sess_PitDecision_ChooseTyreAndFuel and Game_PitLane_VehicleWantsToLeaveGarage_Thunk, sets car_ctx+0x130 flag 0x20 and bit 1, and sets DAT_146103358 = now + random in [min,max] (defaults 6..18 s, or 1.5..3.5 s when DAT_14610335c is set; overridable from tuning at (+0xb8)+0x10..+0x48). Otherwise upserts {car, time} into the queue (shared tail Sess_PitDecision_UpsertPitCommitList). Modders: DAT_146103358 and the 6/18 and 1.5/3.5 constants control spacing of AI cars leaving the garage.
